title: Effects of Omega-3 Fatty Acids Supplement in Cognition of Young Healthy Adults and in Their Reaction Time of Computerized Test After 3 Months of Taking High-concentrated DHA and EPA Fish Softgels

sections.abstract: In this trial, the investigators are going to investigate the improvement of cognitive brain domains after ingestion of omega 3 products that have high concentrations of DHA, Docosahexaenoic acid, and EPA, Eicosapentaenoic acid, in comparison to control group young healthy adults. The study will assess the improvement by computerized testing by their reaction time before and after the intervention. The researchers will follow the scientific and ethical regulations prevent any harmful effect on recruited subjects.
